premises.text: Brick-and-mortar still drives most retail sales but lacks the personalized rich data customers get online
premises.evidence_span: 95% of sales still comes from brick-and-mortar stores

premises.text: In-store brands see anonymous transactions with no customer personality, so they cannot tell what each shopper wants
premises.evidence_span: when you walk into a store, how the brands feel is really, quite frankly, a little confused. All of us could be in the same store, and to all of them, it looks like different transactions. But there's no personality behind it

premises.text: The product assigns shopper personality via POS so brands can send receipts with recommended products and rich visuals
premises.evidence_span: we leverage the point of sales system. So that, let's say, when Bruce Wayne is checking out, and you know he's someone who's a business kind of purchaser, and he just cares about his time and the brand, he'll walk in, buy something, we can send him a copy of the receipt, and alongside it, put in all those rich visuals with the recommended products

premises.text: A visual dashboard turns retail numbers into growth drivers, customer lists, and per-person sales so brands know what to fix
premises.evidence_span: we want to turn those numbers into a really visual dashboard and an easy way for brands to tell not only how their sales are doing, but what they can do about it

premises.text: Initial market is mid-to-high luxury standalone fashion brands that care about customer experience
premises.evidence_span: We went after the individual brands in the mid to high luxury tier fashion retailer

value.text: Personalize the brick-and-mortar retail store experience for customers and brands
value.evidence_span: how we're going to personalize the retail store experience

secondary_value.text: Give brands actionable insight into who is driving growth or decline
secondary_value.evidence_span: not only how their sales are doing, but what they can do about it

causal_links.evidence_span: You don't get any of that rich data when you walk into a store
put in all those rich visuals with the recommended products
These people care about providing the best experience for the customers
